author: tbolt
description: A lean, local-first vehicle service log. Track every vehicle's maintenance and repairs, keep service intervals honest with due-date and mileage reminders, log registrations and inspections, and watch what the car really costs per mile. Data lives on your NAS.

tips.before_install:
## Garage Log

Data (vehicles, maintenance and repair logs, reminders, registrations) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/garage-log/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Garage Log
release_note: - Initial release: self-hosted vehicle service records with on-NAS storage.
